rule: A region rated >= 3 (1-5) on 2 consecutive check-ins drops its families one rung for a week
summary: Repeated self-report of a body region (OSTRC-style) captures overuse problems that single reports or time-loss miss, and subjective measures track load response well (Saw 2016). Requiring 2 consecutive days filters single-day noise while a single Red rating (>= 4) still acts immediately. The number 2 is a heuristic; no study tests it.

sources.note: OSTRC weekly questionnaire (knee/low back/shoulder): repeated self-report captures far more overuse problems than time-loss reporting
Saw 2016 SR (56 studies): subjective self-report measures track training load more sensitively than objective markers
Delphi LBP flare definition: a worsening lasting hours to weeks, hard to tolerate, impacting usual activities
